pdf_page_count raises an error when the input is not a PDF

```rust title="Rust"
use xberg::pdf_page_count;

fn main() {
    let pdf_bytes = std::fs::read(concat!(env!("CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR"), "/../../test_documents/text/plain.txt")).expect("test_documents/text/plain.txt must exist");
    let password: Option<String> = None;
    let result = pdf_page_count(&pdf_bytes, password.as_deref());
    match result {
        Ok(value) => println!("{:?}", value),
        Err(error) => println!("{error}"),
    }
}
```
